title: English rung 08: Idioms and phrasal verbs

questions.question: Choose the meaning of: **to beat around the bush**.
options: to avoid coming to the point
questions.explanation: It means to talk about other things instead of the main issue.

questions.question: Choose the meaning of: **a hot potato**.
options: a controversial issue nobody wants to handle
questions.explanation: A hot potato is something awkward to deal with.

questions.question: Choose the meaning of: **to cost an arm and a leg**.
Choose the meaning of: **the last straw**.
options: the final problem that makes a situation unbearable
questions.explanation: From "the straw that broke the camel's back".

questions.question: Choose the meaning of: **to kill two birds with one stone**.
options: to achieve two aims with one action
questions.explanation: It means to solve two problems at once.

questions.question: Choose the meaning of: **to be on cloud nine**.
questions.explanation: It means to feel great joy.

questions.question: Choose the meaning of: **at the drop of a hat**.
questions.explanation: It means at once, at the slightest excuse.

questions.question: Choose the meaning of: **to call off (a meeting)**.
Choose the meaning of: **to put up with**.
questions.explanation: "Put up with" means to accept something unpleasant.

questions.question: Choose the meaning of: **to look into (a problem)**.
questions.explanation: "Look into" means to examine or investigate.

questions.question: Choose the meaning of: **to give up**.
Choose the meaning of: **to turn down (an offer)**.
Choose the meaning of: **to run out of (supplies)**.
questions.explanation: "Run out of" means to use up completely.

questions.question: Choose the meaning of: **a storm in a teacup**.
options: a big fuss about something small
questions.explanation: It describes excitement over a trivial matter.

questions.question: Choose the meaning of: **to go the extra mile**.
options: to make more effort than expected
questions.explanation: It means to do more than is required.
